probe_evidence: pageNumber is ZERO-BASED. numHits=100 with pageNumber=1 returns DataList:[] for CD20-2 and for P-12470 while reporting totalHits 4 and 45; the identical request with pageNumber=0 returns 4 and 45 rows.
